meta.description: An artillery calculator made for Multicrew Tank Combat on Roblox.

adjustFire.corrected: Your position was moved to match where the round landed
adjustFire.title: Last round

typography.heightmap: This map features a heightmap for improved accuracy
typography.instructions: <kbd>LMB</kbd> to set your position. <kbd>RMB</kbd> to set the target's position. <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>RMB</kbd> to mark where your round landed and correct your position. Hold <kbd>MMB</kbd> to move the map around, and scroll wheel to zoom.
